analysis:
This batch contains only test files. Qwen35CheckpointRetentionLiveTests.swift (head 113-136) changes the expected retained positions for the short-donor test. The deepest kept checkpoint is now an end-of-prompt boundary: latest = (tokens.count-1-64) rounded down to blockSize, required to be at least 1,024 tokens beyond the 6,144 chunk end. The test still expects exactly 3 files and per-tenant scope tenant-b. QwenVLMTargetExtractionTests.swift (head 335-366) adds unit coverage for EngineV2Factory.demandedLatestCheckpointMinimumTokens. It returns store.config.minEffectiveTokens only for a dense model on the paged backend with a paged SSD store, and nil for MoE, contiguous backends, nil stores and contiguous stores. The capture-boundary partition stays nil for dense.

Security relevance under T-041/SEC-035: the PR implies a new production behavior, a demanded end-of-prompt (latest) checkpoint donation. That donation persists a recurrent-state checkpoint closer to the prompt end, within 64 tokens. This extends the at-rest ciphertext depth per donation but does not change the encryption, HMAC naming, TTL or salt scoping visible here. The tests assert the minimum-effective-token floor is preserved, and the file count stays at 3, so total retained positions per donor are not inflated.

No production source is supplied. For integration, verify these points in the production change:
(1) CBv2SchedulerConfig.demandedLatestPromptEndMarginTokens and EngineV2Factory.demandedLatestCheckpointMinimumTokens keep the per-donation adoption/benefit gate in SSDPrefixCache.donate.
(2) The end-of-prompt boundary still folds cacheSalt into the chain hash and lookup tag.
(3) No new DBK3 metadata fields (e.g. prompt length or end-margin) are added to the AAD or plaintext.
(4) Staging and reservation release paths are unchanged.

Test-only changes introduce no regression themselves.
